mentions.name: Tetranea
mentions.description: A mobile puzzle game for iPhone and iPad that combines a Tetris-like fill-rows-and-columns mechanic with roguelike deck-building: players improve a deck across boards of ever-increasing complexity and use cards with special powers. Built in Love2D, free to play with some options behind an in-app purchase; live on the App Store with an Android version planned.
mentions.problem: Similar fill-row-and-column games are frustrating because they have ads and arbitrarily make it impossible to keep going, apparently to show more ads.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I combined my love of roguelike deck-builders and made a game for her. It's the same basic premise of filling rows and columns but it has a deck you improve over several boards of ever-increasing complexity. And it has cards with special powers (of course.)

mentions.name: Tetranea
mentions.description: A casual/strategy deck-builder and tile-placer game designed to be relaxing while still offering some challenge, releasing first on the App Store with Play Store and other platforms to follow.
mentions.audience: Players who want a relaxing game with some challenge
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a casual/strategy game that will be released in the App Store very soon (followed by Play Store and others as I have time). https://tetranea.net/ It is a deck-builder, tile-placer aimed at an audience who wants a relaxing game with some challenge.
